normal_fall: Create ONE standalone game sprite, NORMAL_FALL pose, using the attached PLAYER concept board strictly as the character identity reference. Do not reproduce the board. One character, one pose, square canvas, genuine transparent background. Preserve this exact cute tiny chestnut-haired animal-eared human girl: large head, recognizable brown bangs and small hair tuft, triangular brown ears with white inner fur, pale human face, simple dark eyes, brown outfit with white chest detail and tiny red accents, large fluffy brown-and-white banded tail, chunky gunboots. NOT a new character, not a dog hood. No handheld gun. Pose: rapid passive downward fall, face upright and readable in front/very slight three-quarter view, feet pointing DOWN, visible boot soles/nozzles downward, compact narrow body, arms close beside torso, hair tips swept UP and the large tail streaming UP along one side behind head. Tail markings must stay clearly white and brown. Crisp low-resolution pixel art designed specifically for a 48x48 logical-pixel cell. Use chunky deliberate pixel clusters, a restrained shared palette of around 24 colors, dark brown outline plus sparse warm cream edge highlights readable against black. Hard square pixel edges only, no antialiasing, no soft shading, no blur. Draw at high resolution as an integer enlargement of low-resolution pixel art, keeping the effective detail appropriate for 48x48. Center torso pivot at canvas center. Character and tail fully inside canvas with at least 3 logical pixels transparent margin. Head including ears about 20 logical pixels wide; complete silhouette about 35-40 logical pixels tall. No lettering, labels, frame, ground, background, shadow, muzzle flash, projectile, thrust, dust or sparkles. This will be the identity and pixel-scale master for three subsequent poses.
